newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat sees no trades for a second day.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat sees no trades for a second day.

text.p: Trading in wheat futures remained dormant on Tuesday, with no recorded trades for the second consecutive day.
At the close of floor trading, the nearby March contract was at a settlement price of A$161.00 a tonne.

Grains traders said a steady estimated pool equities returns price on Monday of A$185 a tonne for Australian Standard White wheat and rising deliveries for export to the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) is discouraging trade in futures.
The AWB on Monday left the pools price estimate unchanged and said some 18.5 million tonnes of an estimated bumper wheat harvest of 21.5 million tonnes had been delivered.
Indications by the AWB that most domestic millers had satisfied nearby requirements and that the focus was shifting to the feed grain market was also numbing trading interest.
